instruction.text:
Is there an equivalent fraction to 1/3 that has a denominator of 12 ?
First, decide whether the answer to this division is a whole number.

hint.text: Whole numbers are numbers like 1, 2, 3, 4 and so on. Decimal numbers and fractions are not whole numbers.

end.text: 12:3 is a whole number. Therefore, there is an equivalent fraction to 1/3 with a denominator of 12.
end.sound: ssml: 12 divided by three is a whole number. Therefore, there is an equivalent fraction to 1/3 with a denominator of 12.

instruction.text: Multiply the numerator by 4 to find an equivalent fraction with the denominator 12.

Is there also an equivalent fraction to 1/3 that has a denominator of 10?
First, decide whether the answer to this division is a whole number.

hint.text: Whole numbers are numbers like 1, 2, 3, 4 and so on. Decimal numbers and fractions are not whole numbers.

end.text: 10:3 is not a whole number. Therefore, there is not an equivalent fraction to 1/3 with a denominator of 10.
end.sound: ssml: 10 divided by 3 is not a whole number. Therefore, there <emphasis>is not</emphasis> an equivalent fraction to 1/3 with a denominator of 10.
